Transform-mask golden etalons.
Captured from master BEFORE the Phase-81 allow_transform deletion, then
re-captured at atlas format v7 and again once the QUAD_* hint started firing
(both move the SHA; the region dumps are unaffected).
Single-threaded (NT_BUILDER_THREADS=1), nt_atlas_opts_defaults().
Atlas name "transform_golden" — the name seeds the texture page resource ids,
so the SHA depends on it; re-capture with any other name will not match.
etalon_all      = allow_transform=true  sha256 51dea1b54232808d06d513b147481f60b1f0e5c873071adad4d5f32d075ef7bb
etalon_identity = allow_transform=false sha256 acd7de67fc8b522c56b0b9cffa982114aed8007e7998f3fe4a2b76af5defbcc6
test_atlas_transform_mask re-packs the same fixture with allowed_transforms=0xFF/0x01
and asserts byte-identity against these dump + sha256 files.
Both packs are captured with atlas dedup explicitly OFF, so these etalons are a
pure transform-mask contract; dedup output is pinned by tests/fixtures/dedup_golden.
The recorded SHAs did not move when dedup was switched off — the fixture's
per-sprite colours mean nothing in it ever folded.
To regenerate after an INTENTIONAL packer change: run test_atlas_transform_mask,
then take the SHA-256 and region dump of build/tests/tmp/xform_golden_all.ntpack
and xform_golden_identity.ntpack (the test prints the current dump on divergence).

NTPACK v3 migration (2026-09-10): recaptured pack SHA after replacing
manifest format_version with owner_entry. Restoring only the v2 header version
and former manifest versions reproduced every previous SHA exactly. Payloads
and structural region dumps are unchanged.
